command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '===IDENTITY==='
hostname; whoami
echo '===OMEGA_CHECKOUTS==='
for d in /home/ai-core-node/omega-bootstrap/oMEGA /home/ai-core-node/oMEGA; do
  if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then
    echo "CHECKOUT=$d"
    git -C "$d" remote -v | sed -n '1,2p'
    printf 'HEAD='; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'BRANCH='; git -C "$d" branch --show-current
    printf 'DIRTY='; if [ -n "$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain)" ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi
  fi
done
echo '===OMEGA_USER_UNITS==='
systemctl --user list-units --type=service --all --no-pager | grep -Ei 'omega|frankenstein' || true
echo '===OMEGA_PROCESSES==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,cmd --sort=pid | grep -E '[o]mega|[g]rid_runtime|[m]aster_bridge|[o]uter_bridge_worker|[b]ridge_relay' || true
echo '===PERSISTENT_PATHS==='
for p in /var/lib/omega /home/ai-core-node/.local/share/omega /home/ai-core-node/omega-bootstrap/oMEGA/runtime /home/ai-core-node/omega-bootstrap/oMEGA/data; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then echo "EXISTS $p"; find "$p" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | head -80; else echo "ABSENT $p"; fi
done
